newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: RUGBY UNION-OTAGO BEAT CANTERBURY 37-29 IN SUPER 12.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-OTAGO BEAT CANTERBURY 37-29 IN SUPER 12.

text.p: Otago Highlanders beat Canterbury Crusaders 37-29 (halftime 28-20) in a Super 12 rugby match at Carisbrook, Dunedin on Saturday.
Otago Highlanders - Tries: Manasa Bari (2), Anton Oliver. Penalties: Tony Brown (5). Conversions: Brown (2). Drop goal: Brown.
Canterbury Crusaders - Tries: Leon MacDonald, Daryl Lilley. Penalties: Andrew Mehrtens (5). Conversions: Mehrtens (2).
